per_case_results.question: Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    c."id",
    c."name",
    c."artist",
    c."text",
    r."text" AS "ruling_text",
    CASE 
        WHEN c."text" IS NULL THEN 'Missing text'
        WHEN c."power" IS NULL OR c."toughness" IS NULL THEN 'Missing power/toughness'
        WHEN c."manacost" IS NULL THEN 'Missing mana cost'
        WHEN c."type" IS NULL THEN 'Missing type'
        ELSE 'No missing properties'
    END AS "property_status"
FROM "cards" c
LEFT JOIN "rulings" r ON c."id" = r."id"
WHERE c."artist" = 'Stephen Daniel'
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist) AS subquery)) LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: What is the percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text box? List them by their ID.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 AND isStorySpotlight = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(id), 0) FROM cards
per_case_results.actual_sql:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "istextless" = 1) as textless
    FROM "cards"
    WHERE "isstoryspotlight" = 1
)
SELECT "id", (100.0 * (SELECT textless FROM stats) / (SELECT total FROM stats)) as percentage
FROM "cards"
WHERE "isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND "istextless" = 1
ORDER BY "id"
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
per_case_results.expected_sql: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
WITH banned_by_format AS (
    SELECT "format", COUNT(*) AS banned_count
    FROM "legalities"
    WHERE "status" = 'banned'
    GROUP BY "format"
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT "format"
    FROM banned_by_format
    ORDER BY banned_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tf."format", c."name"
FROM "top_format" tf
JOIN "legalities" l ON tf."format" = l."format" AND l."status" = 'banned'
JOIN "cards" c ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"

per_case_results.question: Which cards are ranked 1st on EDHRec? List all of the cards name and its banned play format.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.edhrecRank = 1 AND T2.status = 'Banned' GROUP BY T1.name, T2.format
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT c."name", l."format"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."edhrecrank" = 1
AND l."status" = 'banned'
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, CASE WHEN T1.status = 'Legal' THEN T1.format ELSE NULL END FROM legalities AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T2.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT "c"."name", "l"."format"
FROM "cards" "c"
JOIN "legalities" "l" ON "c"."uuid" = "l"."uuid"
WHERE "c"."setcode" = 'HOU'
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM sets WHERE code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean' AND NOT language LIKE '%Japanese%')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name"
FROM "sets" "s"
INNER JOIN "set_translations" "st_kr" ON "s"."code" = "st_kr"."setcode" AND "st_kr"."language" = 'Korean'
LEFT JOIN "set_translations" "st_jp" ON "s"."code" = "st_jp"."setcode" AND "st_jp"."language" = 'Japanese'
WHERE "st_jp"."setcode" IS NULL
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.frameVersion, T1.name, CASE WHEN T2.status = 'Banned' THEN T1.name ELSE 'NO' END FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Allen Williams'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
